{{Top|leg|title=Attack on the ''Prosecutor''}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], while the ''[[Prosecutor]]'' was patrolling the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] transmissions were intercepted by the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. It then came under attack from [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], who took control of the ship before a distress signal could be made. After two weeks without any contact with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], it reappeared in the [[Corbantis system/Legends|Corbantis system]] in the [[Chaykin Cluster]]. Due to the large number of clones aboard, several survived until the Republic sent a group of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]], [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], to [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|investigate]].<ref name="SWRC">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>
